By Occasion

Wine for Every Occasion in Murfreesboro

Not sure what wine fits the moment? The Liquor & Wine Outlet team helps customers match wines to specific occasions every day. Here's how to think about it.

Weeknight Dinner

Approachable everyday reds and whites $12–$25 — bright Sauvignon Blanc, easy-drinking Pinot Noir, unoaked Chardonnay, or a fruit-forward Malbec.

Dinner Party

Show-off bottles $30–$80 — Napa Cabernet, Barolo, White Burgundy, or vintage Champagne. Bring the menu into the store for pairing help.

Gifts & Milestones

Wines with the recipient's birth year, prestige-cuvée Champagne, or a curated three-bottle vertical. Staff can wrap and stage for pickup.

Weddings & Events

Volume pricing on wines matched to your guest count and menu. Call (615) 624-6928 to plan quantities and timing.
